subject: Acme renewal & expansion — follow-up + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Dunn <alice.dunn@acme.com>, Bob Rivera <bob.rivera@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme renewal & expansion — follow-up + next steps

Hi Alice / Bob — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Key pain points you confirmed:
- Rising inference spend (Q2 saw ~45% increase in per-token cost vs Q1) and lack of predictable unit economics
- Latency incidents impacting the search/assistant flow (p95 spikes ~700ms during peak)
- Need to support a new document ingestion workload (PDF/attachments -> embeddings) without exploding cost

Goals we discussed:
- Reduce per-token spend by ~30% across production workloads within the next quarter
- Get tail latency (p95) under 250ms for user-facing routes
- Run a 2-week private pilot for the ingestion/embeddings pipeline and evaluate quality/cost

What Redwood will provide:
1) Usage review + optimization plan (attached usage_report_Q2_2026.csv) — initial opportunities: prefix caching for the assistant, model quantization for the batch embedding job, and optimized batching for soaring tails
2) Pilot proposal + SOW draft (we’ll send SOW-draft-Acme-v2.pdf)
3) Two pricing paths to consider: a Reserved Dedicated pool (committed) vs. Pilot + pay-as-you-go with a volume discount tier

Immediate next steps (proposed timeline):
- This week: Redwood sends SOW draft & pricing options (Marissa/Ethan) — target Thu 8/13
- Next week: Acme confirms pilot scope + procurement kick-off (Alice/Bob) — target 8/17
- Pilot start: week of 8/24 for two weeks; final decision by 9/15 to align with renewal window

Let me know if I missed anything. I’ll loop in Monica from CS for onboarding and pilot runbook after you sign off on scope.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachments: usage_report_Q2_2026.csv

Thanks, Marissa — this matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side:

- Confirmed: cost is the primary blocker for expanding embeddings usage right now. Reducing unit cost is top priority.
- Timeline: Procurement is available to start the paperwork the week of 8/17; we need commercial terms and estimated monthly committed spend to push forward.
- Pilot scope: we want the pilot to include ingesting ~500k documents (PDFs + office docs) and a side-by-side quality check vs our current pipeline.

On procurement: I’m looping Procurement so they see the timeline. Can you include a short purchase order template or commercial summary with the SOW so our legal/procurement team can review quickly?

Onward — Alice

Marissa / Monica — attaching the SOW draft and two pricing options as discussed. Summary below:

Option A — Pilot (no commitment):
- 2-week pilot (week of 8/24)
- Dedicated pilot cluster sized for the ingestion job (estimated 8 A100-hours/day)
- Pilot cost: $24,500 (one-time) + usage at pay-as-you-go rates for incremental tokens

Option B — Reserved (3-month commit):
- Reserved GPU pool for production embeddings and assistant routes
- Volume discounts kick in at 500M tokens/month
- Monthly committed spend: $85,000 (can amortize against pilot if they convert)

I also included a short commercial summary page at the front of the SOW to speed procurement review (PO template + acceptance criteria).
